summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry for the title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning a bool, with the required docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title with the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title (mocked wrapper). Nothing was run, per instructions; all checks were by reading. Choices: the console test skips on sys.platform == "win32" as the proxy for legacy Windows; no changes were made to the buffer flush path, which already routes to the legacy renderer. No commits were made.
